 The Los Angeles Lakers are amid a scorching stretch, winning eight straight games for a 12-2 record, tied with the San Antonio Spurs for first place in the team standings.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Luka Doncic has been nothing but phenomenal, displaying the all-around genius that convinced the Purple and Gold that he is the franchise's cornerstone. But it has been a collective effort for the Lakers , with Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler, Jake LaRavia , Matisse Thybulle , Ziaire Williams, Sandro Mamukelashvili, Quentin Grimes, and Collin Sexton making contributions.
 Before facing the Charlotte Hornets at Crypto.com Arena on Tuesday, Thybulle highlighted the overlooked part of LaRavia's game, as reported by ESPN's Dave McMenamin.
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 "I feel like teams still don't realize how good a defender he is. The way he and I look at the game, the metrics don't really matter. He and I are out there just trying to make sure everyone's matched up with their guys, and then we can clean up the rest," said Thybulle.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "So for other teams to still try to put him in action, it's kind of ridiculous. With the exception of the fouling as of late, he's a really solid defender. He's much faster, much more athletic, much bigger than people think, and the effort he gives on the defensive end is really, really solid."
 In his second season with the Lakers, LaRavia is averaging 6.1 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 2.2 assists in 25.1 minutes off the bench.
 Click Here to Subscribe But as Thybulle stressed, the 25-year-old wingman's value is not always seen on the stat sheet, dispelling the notion that he is solely a shooter.
 Coach JJ Redick has repeatedly harped on pushing hard on defense, and LaRavia has heeded the call.
